group_note: NT/nitan lineage but not byte-identical to nitan170911/nitan6 -- ported the §7.15 dbase-architecture fix (check_config.lpc, simul_efun.lpc, wizard.lpc, +ansi_util/db_compat fragments) from nitan170911. WASM pass: fixed the GBK is_chinese() (codepoint-based now), halved check_legal_name()'s length bound, fixed origin()==ORIGIN_LOCAL/CALL_OUT/CALL_OTHER (§7.47) across 12 files (feature/team.lpc, 10 weapon files, ahackerd.lpc), applied the loopback-allow patch to band.lpc, removed NTOS-specific query/set_heartbeat_interval() calls with no FluffOS equivalent (timed.lpc/systemd.lpc), removed mudlistd.lpc's sockets-package usage (no sockets under this driver) and fixed a bare `array` type declaration bug (mudlistd.lpc:125). Boots clean with zero compile errors under WASM. This lib's own banner/preload sequence takes an unusually long real-time to render (15-20+ seconds), which made scripted registration testing with mudclient.py/wasm_client.js repeatedly hit timing edge cases (not a mudlib bug) -- full interactive registration not conclusively verified in this pass despite multiple attempts; admin (fluffos, admin rank) seeded via adm/etc/wizlist but not verified with an actual login.
